title: Scarlet lip under a beauty dish

tokens.v: A tight beauty close-up against the red seamless: she draws the scarlet lipstick across her lower lip, eyes to camera, the case held so its lacquer catches the dish. She wears a sleek black high-neck top. The silver beauty dish is out of frame above, its crisp shadow under her chin. 100mm, framed from brow to collarbone, skin with real texture.
